title: Neptume Onboarding
tagline: Crypto onramp made as simple as possible. Use LLMs to create DeFi account and/or use it for assistance during the process.
description: This project is a seamless crypto onramp experience designed to simplify the process of getting started with DeFi for users. The app integrates Coinbase SDK for wallet management, Covalent agents for blockchain data querying and agents, and Vite for a fast and modern front-end development environment.
how_its_made: The project combines powerful technologies like Coinbase SDK, Covalent, and LLMs to simplify and enhance the crypto onboarding process. By leveraging Vite, React, and Tailwind, the platform offers a seamless and fast user experience. The integration of these technologies allowed me to create a crypto onramp that is both user friendly and with rich features, with real time guidance and blockchain data fetching. The use of LLMs to assist users and Covalent for blockchain querying made this project unique and efficient in delivering value to users entering the crypto space.
